Card Q&A.a: No, it can't. Even if a card digivolves from a card that was placed on the field in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn. It can only attack in the turns after it's played.
Card Q&A.q: If this Digimon digivolves from a [Erika Mishima] that was played this turn, can it attack in the same turn?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] If you have [Mother Eater] in the breeding area, you may play up to 6 play cost's total worth of Digimon cards with the [Eater] trait from your hand without paying the costs.
